headline: Size‑up after losses is costing you

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The cost of this behaviour is ₹1,05,732. It occurred in 96 trades, with a median entry size after a loss of ₹12,562 versus ₹6,578 otherwise, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. The after‑loss win rate was 28% compared with 39% otherwise, and those trades were a loss of ₹1,95,375.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is something to keep an eye on.

closing: You might want to follow the rule on staying at your usual size after a loss in the next review period.
